Uses of Package
io.github.tobyjamesclements.parsley

  • Classes in io.github.tobyjamesclements.parsley used by io.github.tobyjamesclements.parsley
    Class
    Description
    CausalStreams
    The running application: a curated view of the Kafka Streams runtime, assembled by Parsley.streams(Properties) and started here.
    Codec
    A pure byte codec: two total functions between a value and its bytes.
    Emission
    One output of user logic: a key and value bound for a topic, as a value.
    Fold
    Stateful user logic: a pure step function over per-key state.
    Handler
    Stateless user logic: a pure function from a delivered message to the emissions it causes.
    Message
    A causally delivered message: the decoded key and value plus the message's own coordinate — its source topic, partition, offset, and timestamp.
    Parsley
    The front door: a composition of Stages, and the two ways to run it — a broker-less topology for TopologyTestDriver, or a CausalStreams runtime against a real cluster.
    Stage
    One causal processing stage: typed source topics, each handled by pure user logic (a Handler or, with per-key state, a Fold), and typed sink topics — with the causal boundary in between.
    Stage.Builder
    Builds a stateless stage; Stage.Builder.state(Codec, Supplier) upgrades it to a stateful one.
    Stage.Stateful
    Builds a stateful stage: sources may fold over the declared per-key state.
    Step
    The result of one Fold application: the state to persist for the key (null deletes it) and the emissions the message caused.
    Topic
    A typed topic: name and codecs declared once, then shared.
